I highly recommend Maspeth Animal Hospital. I have brought my cats there for both illnesses and surgery, and every visit has been a positive experience.

Dr. Rami Henin truly cares about animals. He is compassionate, highly knowledgeable, provides excellent advice, and is thorough with his diagnoses. I always feel confident that my cats are receiving the best possible care.

I also want to recognize Adrianna at the front desk. She is always friendly, helpful, organized, and makes every visit smooth and welcoming.

The entire team is professional and caring. If I could give them 10 stars instead of 5, I absolutely would. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my cats!
